name: 70% Dark Chocolate Organic PE
description:
Dark Chocolate Organic PE

Dark Chocolate Organic PE Three Psilocybin PE Dark Chocolate Bar is divine in more ways than one. We take pride in our ingredients and our small batch process. We use 70% dark Criollo cacao that is organic, fair-trade and source from lowland regions of Ecuador, which is blended with locally- grown Penis Envy magic mushrooms. The Criollo cacao provides a rich and satisfying taste without the bitterness that accompanies typical dark chocolate. Our chocolate is hand-crafte using low temperatures and slower processing to preserve the nutrients, micronutrients and antioxidants inside the chocolate.

Our chocolate bar is perfect for micro-dosing or sharing a trip with friends.

Please be responsible, 3 grams of Penis Envy is consider a VERY strong dose, and if you consume the whole bar in one sitting we highly recommend you have a friend or loved one to act as a sitter for the impending trip 🚀 .
